cues: A or an is decided by sound, not spelling.
A before a consonant sound: a university and a uniform begin with a you sound; a European country; a one rupee coin begins with a w sound; and a horse, where the h is sounded.
An before a vowel sound: an umbrella; an hour and an honest man, where the h is silent; an M A and an M P, because the letter M is read em; an X ray and an N G O.
So he is an university student is wrong: a university student.
